answer.summary: No linguistic evidence of temporal inference or memory coherence mechanisms exists in arXiv:2406.09876 under non-sequential, burst-based input conditions as specified in the research objective.
answer.content: After independent verification by researcher and deliverable review, the abstract and metadata of arXiv:2406.09876 contain no explicit or inferential linguistic indicators of temporal inference, state continuity, or implicit sequencing in fragmented input streams. The focus on low-dimensional embeddings and geometric fidelity does not extend to mechanisms for maintaining memory coherence in asynchronous, non-sequential data. This confirms a complete absence of support for the proposed memory coherence mechanisms within the available textual evidence. A bounded revision is requested to clarify whether the research objective should shift to include alternative memory mechanisms or different input conditions.
